findings.statement: Nested RedactedDiagnostic model_construct/model_copy corruption originally emitted a secret-bearing Pydantic warning and escaped as PydanticSerializationError from build_bundle. Parent remediated it before final review.
findings.original_evidence: At the pre-fix source, both bypasses produced PydanticSerializationError with input-secret in the exception and warning.
findings.falsification_and_final_evidence: At final target, public-boundary probes corrupt a valid outcome via nested model_construct and model_copy, then call build_bundle. Actual output for both: ContractError code=malformed_contract, secret_in_exc=False, secret_in_warning=False, warnings=0. Source now strictly revalidates the nested diagnostic and build_bundle uses warning-as-error serialization and normalizes ValueError-family failures.
findings.provenance: Introduced in the reviewed uncommitted implementation, reported to Main immediately, then fixed and independently re-tested.

debt_or_limitations: Direct Pydantic model constructors intentionally expose ordinary ValidationError and may include supplied input. This is not the untrusted public boundary: docs explicitly require parse_*/build_bundle/serialize_* at that boundary and prohibit logging raw Pydantic errors. Public-boundary probes confirmed no secret echo.
